items.title: Brook Lopez on Lawrence Frank (Lopez coach in New Jersey when he was a rookie) not being around
items.author: Law Murray 📘
items.body_excerpt:
Brook Lopez on Lawrence Frank (Lopez coach in New Jersey when he was a rookie) not being around

"It's definitely odd, you know, his fingerprints are just all over everything here... he's put so much of his heart and soul into this. He's still with us every day."

items.title: Brook Lopez on Lawrence Frank, whom Lopez played under in Brooklyn and Los Angeles: “It is odd not having him here. His presence is still felt obviously.” Lopez joked that Frank doesn’t really answer his texts anyway so it won’t be that much different.
